In that case there is no refund, and I deliver my work up to that point as usual.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"10.12","text":"If you, or someone at your shoot or event, damages my equipment on purpose or through careless behaviour, you pay the cost to repair or replace it.","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":11,"title":"Moving your date, and weather","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"11.1","text":"You may move your wedding to a new date once at no cost, if I am free on the new date. Everything you have paid moves with you. The new date must be within 12 months of your original date.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"11.2","text":"If I am already booked on your new date, it is treated as a cancellation by you (section 16), counted from your original wedding date.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"11.3","text":"A second change of date costs $500.00.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"11.4","text":"We confirm every new date in writing. That message becomes part of this agreement. If we cannot agree a new date in the time allowed, it is treated as a cancellation by you (section 16), counted from your original date.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"11.5","text":"Weddings and events go ahead in any weather. If it rains, I use covered and indoor spots. Weather is not a reason for a refund.","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":12,"title":"Delivery, gallery and changes","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"12.1","text":"I deliver your edited photos within 3 months of your wedding day. If your booking has more than one shoot day, the time starts after the last one.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"12.2","text":"Delivery time is counted from the day after the shoot. Time I spend waiting for something from you does not count. Examples are a payment, your answers, or your list of film changes.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"12.3","text":"I send you a short preview of your photos within 24 hours of your wedding.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"12.4","text":"I deliver your photos as high resolution JPEG files in a private online gallery.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"12.5","text":"Your gallery stays online for 90 days. Please download everything and keep your own backup in that time. After 90 days I may close the gallery.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"12.6","text":"Changes are for films only. Photo editing follows my style (section 9). If a photo has a real fault, I fix it (section 8).","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":13,"title":"RAW files, and how long I keep your files","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"13.1","text":"RAW files and unedited footage are the files straight from my cameras, before any editing. They are not included in any package.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"13.2","text":"You can buy them at the price in section 4. Ask me in writing and pay within 30 days of your final delivery.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"13.3","text":"After those 30 days, I may delete RAW files and unedited footage for good. I do not have to keep them, even if you ask later.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"13.4","text":"RAW files need special software to open. They are for your private archive. Please do not post them in public as my finished work.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"13.5","text":"As a courtesy, I keep a copy of your delivered photos and films for at least 2 years after delivery. This is not a promise to store them forever. Keeping your own backup is your responsibility.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"13.6","text":"I keep this agreement, your invoices and my delivery records for 7 years.","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":14,"title":"Who owns the photos and films, and what you can do with them","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"14.1","text":"I own the copyright in every photo, film, RAW file and piece of footage I make for you. Nothing in this agreement transfers the copyright to you.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"14.2","text":"When you have paid in full, I give you a personal licence. It lasts forever, and it works anywhere in the world. It is not exclusive, and you cannot sell or transfer it.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"14.3","text":"With this licence you can print the work at any lab, share it with family and friends, post it on your personal social media, and use it for your own invitations, thank you cards, albums and personal or wedding website. Your family and friends may do the same.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"14.4","text":"You cannot do these things without my written permission:","bullets":["sell the work, or license it to anyone;","use it to advertise or promote a business, a product or a service;","give it to a business for its marketing, including a venue, a planner, a makeup artist, a clothing brand, a magazine or a blog. If a vendor wants photos, please send them to me;","enter it in a contest, or submit it for publication;","use it to train an artificial intelligence tool, or to create altered images of people."]},{"type":"clause","n":"14.5","text":"Please post the work as I delivered it. Do not edit it again, add filters, or change it for public posting. Cropping a photo to fit a platform is fine. If you want a different edit, ask me first.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"14.6","text":"When you post my work, a credit or a tag (@kash.klicks) is appreciated.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"14.7","text":"If you use the work in a way this section does not allow, and you do not stop after I ask you in writing, I may end your licence.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"14.8","text":"This section sets out what you may do with the work. It applies in place of the default personal use rule in Canada's Copyright Act.","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":15,"title":"Sharing your work, and your privacy","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"15.1","text":"You have chosen to allow me to share your work as described in this section. This is your choice. If you would rather keep your work private, choose the private option before you sign. It adds a marketing fee of $75.00.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"15.2","text":"Sharing means I may show a selection of your photos and film, with your first names, on kashklicks.ca, on my social media pages, on my Google business profile, in printed samples, in submissions to publications and competitions, and in paid ads. I choose the selection. You are not paid for this use.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"15.3","text":"I will not tag you without asking. I will not share your last name, your contact details or your home address. I keep private moments, such as getting dressed, and any moment you mark as sensitive, off my public pages.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"15.4","text":"If you have sensitive requests, write them in your brief or tell me in writing. Examples are no faces of family members, or no venue name. I will follow them.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"15.5","text":"I do not use a photo where a guest is the main subject in a paid ad without that guest's permission. I do not use photos of children in paid ads without a parent's permission.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"15.6","text":"You can change your mind at any time. Tell me in writing. Within 30 days I remove your work from my website and my social media pages, and I stop using it in new posts and ads. I cannot recall printed material, or copies that other people have already saved or published.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"15.7","text":"You confirm that your partner agrees with the choice made in this section.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"15.8","text":"To do my work, I use trusted services and people. These are an online gallery host, cloud storage and backup, editing software (some with artificial intelligence features), email and messaging, and editors who work with me. Some of them are outside Canada. Your photos and details may be stored or processed in other countries, including the United States and India, under the laws of those countries. I stay responsible for your files.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"15.9","text":"I use your personal details (names, contact details and event details) only to plan and deliver your booking and to keep my records. I do not sell them. You can ask to see or correct the details I hold about you at info@kashklicks.ca. My privacy policy is at kashklicks.ca/privacy.","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":16,"title":"If you cancel","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"16.1","text":"To cancel, tell me in writing. The cancellation counts from the day I receive your message.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.2","text":"Moving your booking to a new date is not a cancellation. See section 11.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.3","text":"If you cancel for a covered reason, I refund a share of everything you have paid. The share depends on how many days are left before your wedding.","bullets":["More than 180 days: 80%.","90 to 180 days: 60%.","60 to 89 days: 40%.","30 to 59 days: 20%.","Fewer than 30 days: no refund is owed, unless I choose to give one, as this section allows."]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.4","text":"A covered reason is one of these: the death, serious illness or serious injury of one of you or of a close family member; your wedding being called off; a military posting; the loss of your job; a move out of Ontario; your venue closing; or an event described in section 19. I may ask for simple proof.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.5","text":"If you cancel for any other reason, for example because you chose another photographer, the retainer is not refunded. I refund a share of what you paid beyond the retainer, using the same list.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.6","text":"If your engagement session has already been photographed, its value of $551.25 is delivered work. I take it off the amount you paid before I work out the refund.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.7","text":"Payments that were not yet due on the day you cancel are no longer owed.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.8","text":"Money I have already spent for your booking at your request, such as travel bookings, is not refunded unless I can get it back.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.9","text":"I may choose to refund more than this section requires in a case of real hardship. If I do, it is a gesture of good faith. It does not change these terms.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.10","text":"I pay any refund within 15 days, by e-transfer.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.11","text":"I may end this agreement if a payment stays unpaid after my reminder, if section 10 gives me the right to leave, or if you ask me to do something illegal or unsafe. That counts as a cancellation by you.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"16.12","text":"Nothing in this section takes away a right to cancel that Ontario's Consumer Protection Act gives you.","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":17,"title":"If I cannot make it","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"17.1","text":"I will not cancel your booking unless something serious stops me, such as illness, injury or a family emergency.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"17.2","text":"If that happens, I first try to send a professional photographer I trust, at the same price to you. I edit the work myself, so the style stays the same. I tell you who it is, and you can say no.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"17.3","text":"If I cannot find someone, or you say no, I refund everything you paid, including the retainer.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"17.4","text":"If I have to stop partway through because of illness or injury, I refund the share of your package price for the time I could not cover.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"17.5","text":"A new date, a replacement photographer you accept, or a full refund is everything I owe you if I cannot make it (section 18).","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":18,"title":"If something goes wrong","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"18.1","text":"I take every reasonable step to protect your photos and films (section 8). Even so, equipment can fail, and files can be lost or damaged.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"18.2","text":"If I cannot deliver any of your work because of a problem on my side, I refund everything you paid.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"18.3","text":"If only part of your work is lost, I refund a fair share of the package price for the missing part.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"18.4","text":"My total responsibility to you under this agreement, for any reason, is limited to the amount you have paid me.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"18.5","text":"I am not responsible for other losses or costs, such as the cost of arranging the shoot or event again, travel, outfits, or hair and makeup.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"18.6","text":"I am not responsible for things I do not control. Examples are the weather, the light, the rules of a venue or an officiant, a permit that is refused, traffic, people who are late, absent or unwilling, guests or vendors who block the view, and changes you make on the day.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"18.7","text":"Nothing in this agreement takes away rights that Ontario's Consumer Protection Act gives you and that cannot be waived, including your right to services of reasonably acceptable quality. Where the law does not allow a limit in this section, that limit does not apply, and the rest of this agreement stays in force.","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":19,"title":"Things outside our control","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"19.1","text":"Some events are outside anyone's control. Examples are a natural disaster, a fire, a flood, a pandemic, a government order, a strike, a power failure, a venue that closes, or travel that is shut down. If such an event stops your shoot or event from going ahead, neither of us has broken this agreement.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"19.2","text":"We first move your booking to a new date within 12 months at no cost. Everything you have paid moves with you.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"19.3","text":"If a new date is not possible, it is treated as a cancellation for a covered reason (section 16), and I may refund more.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"19.4","text":"If the event stops me from working, and not you, section 17 applies instead.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"19.5","text":"Weather on its own is covered by section 11, not by this section.","bullets":[]}]}

{"num":20,"title":"If we disagree","items":[{"type":"clause","n":"20.1","text":"If you are unhappy with anything, please tell me in writing first and give me the chance to fix it. I reply within 5 days.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"20.2","text":"We both try in good faith to solve the problem within 30 days.","bullets":[]},{"type":"clause","n":"20.3","text":"The law of Ontario, and the laws of Canada that apply in Ontario, govern this agreement. If we cannot solve a problem ourselves, the courts of Ontario decide it.","bullets":[]}]}

page.title: Your wedding agreement
lede: Everything we agreed, in plain words.
Seven short parts. Most parts start with the main points, and the full wording is one tap away. The full wording is the agreement, so please read it before you sign. You sign at the end.

glance.label: Photographers
glance.value: Akash Desai, and a second photographer for all 10 hours

page.note: The main points help you read. The full wording is what we both agree to.

parts.title: Your day
points: Saturday 29 May 2027. 10 hours in one block, from 12:00 pm to 10:00 pm.
Where: St. Example Church, Hamilton. Reception in Burlington.
I photograph your day myself. A second photographer is with me for all 10 hours.
Please send me your final timeline, your addresses and your family photo list at least 14 days before.
If the day runs late and I am able to stay, overtime is $301.25 an hour, billed in 30 minute blocks of $150.75. It starts only after a yes from you or your contact person.

This agreement is between you, Elena Marchetti, and me, Akash Desai, operating as AD Photography and KashKlicks. You sign for Daniel Okafor too. My phone is 647 613 7430 and my email is info@kashklicks.ca.

parts.title: What you get
points: At least 400 edited photos in a private online gallery.
A short preview within 24 hours of your wedding.
Your edited photos by Sunday 29 August 2027, which is within 3 months of your wedding.
Your gallery stays online for 90 days. Please download your photos and keep your own backup.
An engagement session: 2 hours, with photos and a short film. Please use it at least 30 days before your wedding.
I bring backup cameras. My main cameras save every photo to two memory cards at the same time.

parts.title: Price and payments
points: You pay by e-transfer to info@kashklicks.ca.
The retainer is not refunded if you cancel, except in the cases part 6 lists.
If a payment is late, I send you a written reminder. If it is still not paid 3 days after the reminder, I may treat it as a cancellation by you.
If you choose to keep your photos private in part 5, a marketing fee of $75.00 is added to your total.
Costs that can come on top, only if they happen: overtime ($301.25 an hour), a second change of date ($500.00), and any extra you add later.

Costs at the places of your day: my parking at every location and any entry fee or ferry ticket at a place you choose (all at cost), a permit or written permission if a place needs one (you arrange it and pay for it), and travel outside the GTA ($0.75 per km). For travel far away or outside Canada I send you a written quote first. Flights, nights away and transport are then charged at cost.
All prices are in Canadian dollars.

parts.title: Your photos and sharing
points: Once you have paid in full, you can print your photos, share them with family and friends, and post them on your personal social media. I keep the copyright.
A business needs my written permission to use them. Examples are your venue or a magazine. Please send them to me.
RAW files are not part of the package. You can add them in part 4, or ask me in writing and pay within 30 days of your final delivery.

parts.title: If plans change
points: You can move your date once at no cost, if I am free on the new date and it is within 12 months of your original date. A second change costs $500.00.

If you cancel for a covered reason, such as serious illness or the wedding being called off, I refund a share of what you have paid. More than 180 days before your wedding: 80%. 90 to 180 days: 60%. 60 to 89 days: 40%. 30 to 59 days: 20%. Fewer than 30 days: no refund is owed. The full list of covered reasons is in section 16.
If you cancel for any other reason, the retainer is not refunded. I refund a share of what you paid beyond the retainer, using the same list.
If your engagement session has already been photographed, its value of $551.25 is taken off what you paid before I work out a refund.
If I cannot come, I first try to send a photographer I trust, at the same price. You can say no. If that does not work, I refund everything you paid.

If I cannot deliver any of your photos because of a problem on my side, I refund everything you paid. If only a part is lost, I refund a fair share. My responsibility is limited to the amount you have paid me. The rights that Ontario's Consumer Protection Act gives you stay in place.
Your wedding goes ahead in any weather. If it rains, I use covered and indoor spots. Weather is not a reason for a refund.
If we disagree, we first try to solve it together. The law of Ontario applies.

parts.title: The legal basics
points: One of you signs for both of you. By signing, you confirm that your partner has read this agreement and agrees to it.
By signing, you confirm that you are 18 or older.
A change to this agreement needs both of us, in writing. Email or WhatsApp is enough.
You get a PDF copy by email right after you sign.

sharing.legend: May I share some of your photos?
points: Sharing means I may show a selection of your photos and film, with your first names, on my website, my social media and my Google business profile, in printed samples, in submissions to publications and competitions, and in paid ads.
I do not share your last name, your contact details or your home address, and I do not tag you without asking.
You can change your mind at any time. Tell me in writing. Within 30 days I take your work off my website and my social media pages, and I stop using it in new posts and ads.
I cannot take back printed material, or copies that other people have already saved or published.
